posts.hook: Fraud attempts hit 79% of businesses. Only 22% recovered the funds afterward.
posts.key_stat: 79% faced fraud attempts; 22% recovered funds (AFP 2026 survey, 465 practitioners)
posts.source: Association of Finance Professionals, 2026 Payments Fraud and Control Survey
posts.visual_direction: Bold two-stat contrast card pairing 79% attempts against 22% recovery to frame the exposure as a timing gap, not a detection gap.
